requested_operation: implement separately documented SafeTensors sharded-index parsing, deterministic writing, tensor-to-shard resolution, duplicate detection, and root-confined path policy

inputs.root_cause: The production package implemented single-file SafeTensors containers but exposed no separate model or lifecycle for the de facto model.safetensors.index.json sharding convention. Consumers therefore had no deterministic, duplicate-safe, path-confined way to map tensor names to shard files.
inputs.affected_layer: SafeTensors framework-neutral model, JSON codec, public exports, package documentation, and installed-wheel behavior

implementation.model: immutable SafeTensorsShardIndex with defensive mapping proxies for weight_map, metadata, and safe unknown top-level fields
implementation.reader: UTF-8 JSON path, stream, text, and byte parsing with duplicate-key rejection at every object level
implementation.writer: canonical compact UTF-8 JSON with stable recursive key ordering
implementation.resolution: shard_for, tensors_for_shard, and resolve_shard support deterministic tensor-to-file lookup
implementation.path_policy: shard references must be non-empty normalized relative POSIX paths; absolute, backslash, dot, and parent traversal references are rejected; resolved paths are checked against the configured root after filesystem resolution
implementation.preservation: unknown top-level JSON members are retained independently from reserved metadata and weight_map fields
implementation.public_api: SafeTensorsShardIndex, load_index, loads_index, dump_index, and dumps_index exported under format_factory.safetensors
implementation.tradeoff: sharded indexes are modeled as a separate JSON lifecycle rather than overloading the binary SafeTensors document lifecycle; this keeps the binary format contract stable but introduces explicit parallel entry points
